Mani Ratnam's Inji Vellam opens in cinemas worldwide on Friday, 29 January 2027, the makers, Madras Talkies and Lyca Productions, announced on Wednesday.

The romantic drama is the first film to pair Vijay Sethupathi and Sai Pallavi, with music by A.R. Rahman. It was shot in Kolkata, and India Talkies co-produces.

Which Mani Ratnam love story do you still go back to?

Full story on idly.news (link in bio).
